entities.name: Runo Stromkirk
entities.description: Progenitor of the Stromkirk vampire line and high priest of an ancient sea god cult on Innistrad.

entities.name: Krothuss
entities.description: A legendary kraken Runo wants to summon, said to be more powerful than the Kralmar.

entities.name: Kralmar
entities.description: A sea creature worshipped by cultists.

entities.name: Eternal night
entities.description: The onset that convinced Runo to summon Krothuss.

events.summary: Runo established his dominion at Drunau and supported craftsmen and vampire-friendly alchemists.
events.quote: he established his dominion at Drunau in Nephalia

events.summary: Runo settled with the cult of Krothuss.
events.quote: His spiritual craving wasn't satisfied until he settled down with the cult of Krothuss

events.summary: With eternal night, Runo decided to summon Krothuss.
events.quote: Runo has decided the time is nigh to summon Krothuss

relations.note: Seeks to summon; priest of its cult
relations.quote: Runo has decided the time is nigh to summon Krothuss
